name: HGA-Bench v1.1
description: "HGA-Bench v1.1 is a synthetic benchmark dataset for evaluating governed execution in enterprise customer-service AI agents. It contains 192 CRM tasks across 12 authority-sensitive task families covering approval thresholds, approval scope, role authority, multiple approvals, contextual authorization, fraud and risk, prerequisites, request mutation, target and action mutation, stale approvals, delayed execution, and dynamic state. The dataset supports evaluation of Task Success (TS), Escalation Correctness (EC), Authorization-Boundary Compliance (AC), and Governed Task Success (GTS). It also includes benchmark metadata, authority and policy information, reference artifacts, and evaluation outputs supporting the associated HGA-Bench study. The benchmark is designed to distinguish successful task completion from execution that remains within valid organizational authority boundaries."
